n: Root Coding Robot (SAM Labs, formerly iRobot)
t: A small robot that drives on whiteboards and is programmed from a tablet.
steps: Confirm that the Root robot is still sold. The Root line moved to SAM Labs.
Find the current app location. It is unclear after the acquisition.
Install the coding app on a tablet or phone.
Pair the robot with the app.
Place the robot on a magnetic whiteboard and run a first program.
Check the SAM Labs privacy policy before students use the app.
